title: InfiAgent-DABench: Evaluating Agents on Data Analysis Tasks

layout.note: A rectangular circuit of cards: a thick-framed box with the question and CSV table at top left, LLM Agent and Python Sandbox stacked at right with a curved ReAct loop between them, Final Answer at bottom right and Closed-form Label at bottom left. Labelled arrows run clockwise (Prompt, CSV File, down to Final Answer, Reformat / Matching) and a plain arrow drops from the sample box to the label.

lesson: Show a benchmark by tracing one real item through the whole evaluation: the input card with key phrases coloured, the agent's real code and tool output, then the reformatted answer matched against the closed-form label, every arrow named by what it carries.
